name: Yamaha PW80
engine: 79 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, oil injection, automatic clutch
intro: Yamaha's step-up kids' bike. A two-stroke with oil injection and a three-speed with an automatic clutch.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Yamaha dealer to run the VIN as well.
